safety_lead_time.comparison_action: Increase safety lead time from 0.0 to 0.73 days

narrative: Material PL3__M0A903F5 exhibits intermittent-lumpy daily demand (CV=0.609) with 79.8% non-zero days and a stable supply lead time of 5.63 working days (CV=0.129). Two erroneous near-zero lead time observations were removed as data quality corrections. The (r,Q) continuous-review policy is applied: safety stock is right-sized to 34,193 units (vs SAP 68,113), and order quantity is maximised within the binding storage cap of 308,007 units, yielding a 43% reduction in total annual inventory cost while maintaining the 95% service level.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Stable lead times and moderately high-volume demand make a continuous-review reorder point policy with EOQ-based order sizing optimal. The (r,Q) model minimises total holding and ordering costs while providing a clear, actionable trigger for replenishment.
research_insights.boundary_risk: The storage ceiling of 308,006.688 units binds tightly against the sum of safety stock (34,193) and order quantity (273,813). Any upward revision to safety stock must be accompanied by a corresponding reduction in order quantity or an increase in storage capacity. Current configuration leaves only 0.688 units of headroom.
